content_types.name: Signal Alert
content_types.desc: A Prophet plan turned into a cashtag post with a price chart showing where we see opportunity.

content_types.name: Chart of the Day
content_types.desc: A single annotated price or macro chart that tells one clear story without commentary.

content_types.name: Plain-English Explainer
content_types.desc: A short thread or post that explains one market concept so a non-professional can act on it.

content_types.name: Macro Note
content_types.desc: A brief plain read on the big picture (rates, liquidity, growth) and what it means right now.

content_types.name: Report Card
content_types.desc: A public update on how a past call played out: the numbers, the outcome, what we learned.

content_types.name: On Our Radar
content_types.desc: A short list of names we're watching closely this week but haven't acted on yet.

content_types.name: Event Reaction
content_types.desc: A fast-turnaround post reacting to a market-moving event with context and what we'd watch next.

content_types.name: Mover of the Day
content_types.desc: The day's single biggest mover, charted, on its cashtag, with the real move %.

content_types.name: Theme Tape
content_types.desc: One post tagged with 6-10 cashtags covering a group that's moving, the reach king at 0 followers.

queue.body:
$LAUR: 33 was the busiest price of the past six months.
Below 33, that shelf is gone.
$UTHR made today's most-talked-about list. Below 503, the setup is gone.

queue.headline: $ALGM has work to do
queue.body: 36.6 is the entry. Below 27.2, the setup is gone.

queue.headline: $BJ is back at the same ceiling
queue.body: 93.6 has rejected it 6 times.

queue.headline: $HWM just lined up a pattern we track.
queue.body: Across every name we test it on, this combination has resolved higher 67% of the time about a month out over its full tested history, over 1249 occurrences universe-wide, not this one name. A measured tendency on a study split, not our trading record. Chart below.

queue.headline: Semiconductors ripping, +3.4% avg on Friday
queue.body: $SNDK +11.9% $COHU +10.3% $SIMO +8.7% $FORM +7.4% $KLAC +7.3% $MRVL +7.0% $STX +6.3% $NVTS +6.3% The whole group is bid, not one name.
$ATRA director Cherry Brian N bought 104,166 shares, taking the disclosed holding to 2.7x its prior size. The relative change matters.

accounts.name: Founder's desk: the day's tape, two facts set against each other

queue.body: $LEA needs 146 next or the rebound stays unfinished.

queue.headline: Growth holds up. Inflation does too.
queue.body: GDPNow has the economy growing at 4.7% while median CPI runs at 3.1%. The clean macro story still isn't here.
$GPI just started moving. 319 is the entry, not $301.

queue.headline: $SMP has closed green 5 sessions in a row
queue.body: A close below 35 would unwind the rebound.

queue.headline: Soft growth, warm inflation, firm labor
queue.body: Jobless claims are averaging 13.4% below a year ago this month. The slowdown case still lacks labor-market confirmation.
Rep. Kevin Hern sold $15K to $50K of $ICLR, and the filing tells us what traded, not why.

queue.body: jobless claims average 207k this month, 13.4% below last year. labor isn't confirming the growth scare.

$RHP sits below 126, where the most shares changed hands over the past six months.
until price closes above that level, the recent rise hasn't changed the range.
